description.value: Jane's Tea Garden is a specialty tea shop in Richmond offering premium loose-leaf teas sourced from traditional Chinese tea-growing regions, alongside hand-crafted ceramic teaware. The shop operates both as an online retailer and a physical location where visitors can taste teas and explore Chinese tea culture in person. It is a niche destination for tea enthusiasts rather than a full-service café.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 66m; rack at 99m; rack at 99m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a physical retail and tasting location at 180-8780 Blundell Road, Richmond BC, consistent with the OSM address. The site describes JANESTEA as a premium loose-leaf tea and ceramic teaware shop with in-person visits encouraged, but the website is primarily structured as an online store and mentions no cycling-relevant amenities; the OSM record also lacks any bike-parking or accessibility tags. A notable name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Jane's Tea Garden' while the website uses only 'JANESTEA' / 'JanesTea' throughout.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Jane's Tea Garden' but the website consistently uses 'JANESTEA' / 'JanesTea' — may be a rebranding or a different business at the same address.
Website is primarily an e-commerce platform; the physical location's in-person service format (retail only vs. sit-down tasting café) is unclear from available content.
No phone number displayed on the website contact page (only a contact form and email gardencitypostoffice@gmail.com); OSM phone number cannot be confirmed.
OSM tag outdoor_seating=no confirmed; no cycling amenities mentioned anywhere.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The physical location is confirmed active (OSM check_date 2026-05-20; live website), but the business functions primarily as an online retail store with a walk-in component rather than a conventional café. None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed, and the name on the website ('JANESTEA'/'JanesTea') does not match the OSM name ('Jane's Tea Garden'), warranting manual verification before listing.
